_readme: Machine-readable owner/authority map for the live OpenUI synthesis stack (SGS-001, SLM-435).
Every `subsystems[].owner_module` must exist and contain every listed owner_symbols entry as a
class/def/constant name, checked by scripts/verify_ownership_map.py (static AST/text check, no imports).
`authority_tier` must be one of the keys in `authority_tiers`.
Downstream SGS/VCE/PCT/SRP/SIE/RSP work (the rest of the Compatibility and ownership gate milestone) must
cite an existing `subsystems[].id` as its extension point, or set `new_owner_justified: true` with a
one-sentence `justification` explaining why no existing owner fits. See downstream_extension_map.

authority_tiers.compiler-hard: Deterministic, grammar/contract-derived authority. Wrong output is a bug, never a soft preference; verified by static/AST checks, not sampling.
authority_tiers.verifier-hard: Authority derived from running the G0-G12 verifier stack or an equivalent oracle against a candidate; pass/fail is binding, not advisory.
authority_tiers.advisory-learned: Model- or heuristic-derived signal used to rank or prioritize among options that are already legal under a compiler-hard or verifier-hard gate. Never authorizes an illegal output and never substitutes for a missing verifier-hard check.
authority_tiers.oracle-diagnostic: Ground-truth substitution or intervention used to diagnose or attribute causes (e.g. plan-oracle substitution, counterfactual probes). Used for measurement and repair-target construction, not served to users.
authority_tiers.evaluation-only: Scoring, telemetry, or reporting surface. Observes and records; does not gate production decode and is not cited as decode-time authority.

subsystems.name: SemanticPlanV1 program-side plan contract
subsystems.notes: Versioned, provenance-aware, pack-neutral plan IR. Single definition site; all consumers (models/semantic_plan_factors.py, data/semantic_contrast/transforms.py, data/semantic_plan/*) import from here.

subsystems.name: PromptSemanticRequirementsV1 prompt-side partial requirements contract
subsystems.notes: SGS-004 extractor/canonicalize live beside the contract under data/semantic_plan/requirements_extract.py and requirements_canonicalize.py (extract_prompt_requirements, ExtractorRule, EXTRACTOR_RULES, GoldTargetAccessError, canonicalize_requirements, requirement_fact_fingerprints). Advisory-only; refuses gold/target kwargs. Owner_symbols stay on the contract module because verify_ownership_map binds symbols to a single owner_module file.

subsystems.name: VerifiedSynthesisProblemV1 pack-neutral synthesis-request envelope
subsystems.notes: SGS-007 (SLM-444): new owner layered on semantic_plan, verifier_gate_stack, and dsl_pack_registry_canonical without duplicating any of them -- carries a PromptSemanticRequirementsV1 verbatim, references verifier/evaluator identities by string, and bounds search resources without granting search authority. Excludes authority in {compiler-hard, verifier-hard} at the type level, mirroring prompt_requirements, so no request can declare itself compiler-certified merely through this envelope. Generated JSON Schema: src/slm_training/resources/verified_synthesis_problem.schema.json (scripts/sync_verified_synthesis_problem_schema.py --check).

subsystems.name: Semantic-failure taxonomy / evidence labeling
subsystems.notes: Deliberately an adapter over the G0-G12 verifier stack; it versions/labels verifier evidence, it does not re-score it.

subsystems.name: G0-G12 deterministic verifier gate sequence
subsystems.notes: Canonical G0(Lexical)..G12(HumanAudit) gate numbering and pass/fail. Any module that reimplements gate numbering instead of importing this Gate enum is a duplicate risk.

subsystems.name: Eval-time verifier cascade wiring
subsystems.notes: Re-imports Gate/GATE_NAMES from data/verify/stack.py directly; correct precedent for reuse, not a second gate authority.

subsystems.name: Verifier-guided minimal semantic repair targets
subsystems.notes: Fixture-only interim baseline (SPV2-05). Its own docstring defers real verifier-backed counterfactual action values to SLM-131/VSS (counterfactual_probe). Not dead code; a documented pending supersession. VCE-002/SLM-446 added RepairResidualV1 -- a pure projection of SemanticRepairRecordV1/ConflictSlice (plus optional VCE-001 VerifierWitnessV1 reconciliation) into an advisory residual-obligation view; it owns no new authority and is not a second repair registry.

subsystems.name: Plan-level oracle substitution
subsystems.notes: Distinct from semantic_repair's corruption-repair targets: this substitutes ground-truth oracle values for factor-wise diagnosis, not corruption recovery. VCE-004/SLM-447 added PlanInterventionRecordV1/apply_plan_intervention -- an immutable, replayable paired baseline/intervention observation (before/after plan hashes, declared-vs-observed changed factors, frozen model/request/seed/verifier/hardware identity, downstream decision/quality/compute evidence) plus filter_manifest_safe to exclude contamination-bannered records from any manifest. Extends this owner directly; introduces no second substitution authority.

subsystems.name: Verifier-backed counterfactual action-value probe
subsystems.notes: LDI3-03/SLM-131. Named by semantic_repair.py as the eventual authority for verifier-backed repair action values -- currently a parallel, not yet merged, track.

subsystems.name: Judge-based grammar-legal continuation replay
subsystems.notes: Actively imported by decision_events_v2.py and local_decisions.py. Does not cross-reference counterfactual_probe.py; audit should confirm the split is intentional layering, not redundancy.

subsystems.name: Training-pair counterfactual mutation generator
subsystems.notes: DSH2-06/SLM-366. Data-synthesis purpose (one-fact training-pair mutation), distinct from decode-time replay owners above.

subsystems.name: Decode trace recording and replay validation
subsystems.notes: VSS1-04/SLM-64. Validates the event stream produced by DecodeTraceRecorder (owned separately by src/slm_training/harnesses/distill/trace_store.py) against the solver search trace; does not own DecodeTraceRecorder itself.

subsystems.name: Bounded proof-carrying search controller (generic)
subsystems.notes: VSS1-02. Docstring states explicitly: this is the new generic controller; the compiler-forest LatticeSearchState is retained unchanged as the forest-specific adapter. This split is a documented, intentional reconciliation, not an accidental duplicate.

subsystems.name: Compiler-forest-specific lattice search
subsystems.notes: Retained forest adapter beneath valid_state_search_generic; not superseded, not dead code.

subsystems.name: Pre-registered experiment campaign contract
subsystems.notes: AP-007+ runners and every promotion candidate use this contract. No competing implementation found.

subsystems.name: Per-decode-call immutable telemetry
subsystems.notes: Timing/step-count/fastpath hit-miss telemetry collected during inference/eval. PCT-003/SLM-450 added src/slm_training/harnesses/model_build/cold_warm_bench.py (BenchTrialV1, HardwareIdentityV1, run_cold_trial/run_warm_trial/summarize_trials), a fresh-subprocess cold and in-process warm benchmark harness reusing this owner's MEASUREMENT_STAGES/COMPLETENESS_STATES taxonomy directly rather than inventing a second one; extends the bench_* script family (scripts/bench_accel.py etc.), introduces no new telemetry authority. PCT-007/SLM-452 added MechanismActivationV1/build_mechanism_activation directly in decode_stats.py: a common eligible/invoked/abstained/no_op/changed_top_choice/changed_final_program envelope any optional mechanism can emit, fail-closed against representing a never-active mechanism as a successful intervention. evidence_class/default_state stay caller-declared advisory fields (MECHANISM_EVIDENCE_CLASSES is illustrative only) pending SGS-009/SLM-456 (still Backlog), which is the actual future owner of a canonical disposition enum -- this does not fabricate that registry ahead of it.

subsystems.name: Runtime-level telemetry sink
subsystems.notes: Lower-level runtime namespace used by runtime/decode_schedule.py. Consumes/produces DecodeStats; not a re-implementation of it. PCT-002/SLM-449 added a sibling submodule src/slm_training/runtime/telemetry/replay_bundle.py (ReplayBundleV1, build_replay_bundle, append_replay_bundle, iter_replay_bundles, mirror_bundle_best_effort, replay_bundle_integrity_ok -- re-exported through this package's __init__.py) composing DecodeIdentityV1 (decode_telemetry) and solver_replay_violations (solver_replay) into a compact, content-bound, offline-replayable evidence envelope; introduces no new decode/verifier authority and no new store (persistence reuses any ReplayBundleStore-shaped append-only store the caller already has).

subsystems.name: Certified static-LALR completion artifact
subsystems.notes: Checkpoint-bound, safetensors-encoded control-table artifact. Generated via scripts/build_completion_artifact.py; certified by dsl/grammar/fastpath/static_control_domain.py.

subsystems.name: DSL pack registry (canonical, singular)
subsystems.notes: F1/SLM-34. 114 importers across dsl/operators/*, dsl/harness_dsl.py, dsl/grammar/fastpath/*, and web/routes.py (dashboard pack API). This is the live, wired-in pack registry.

subsystems.name: DSL pack registry (shadow, plural) -- DUPLICATE RISK
subsystems.notes: Also cites F1/SLM-34 but is a second, independently-registered pack system (note capitalization DSLPack vs DslPack). Only 7 importers, all under dsl/packs/*, harnesses/reasoning/bench.py, and their tests. See duplicate_subsystem_risks below; flagged for consolidation, not rewritten by this audit (non-goal: no new search/semantic behavior). Registry functions (register_pack/get_pack/list_packs) live in dsl/packs/__init__.py; the DSLPack dataclass itself is defined in dsl/packs/types.py.

subsystems.name: Symbol-only output contract / OUTPUT_CONTRACT_VERSION
subsystems.notes: OUTPUT_CONTRACT_VERSION=2 (checkpoint-incompatible with v1). See known_drift for the doc mismatch this audit reconciles.

subsystems.name: Grammar-capability-derived completion domain
subsystems.notes: Single definition site; used by the fastpath engine to compute legal-symbol candidates.

subsystems.name: DSL/grammar-native tokenizer (symbol-only decode target)
subsystems.notes: DSL_TOKENIZER_VERSION=5, machine-checked against docs/design/agent-harness-parity-audit.md ("DSL_TOKENIZER_VERSION stays 5") by scripts/verify_ownership_map.py CONTRACT_VERSION_CHECKS (SGS-002/SLM-436). Distinct from choice_codec (models/choice_tokenizer.py): this is the lexer-native tokenizer, the choice codec is the fastpath alternative.

subsystems.name: Deterministic choice-sequence codec
subsystems.notes: Fastpath alternative to open-vocab tokenization. Coexists deliberately with the DSL-native tokenizer (is_choice_tokenizer discriminator); not a duplicate.

subsystems.name: Grammar production codec
subsystems.notes: Related production-level codec consumed alongside choice_codec.

subsystems.name: Typed symbolic-expression IR, codec, and symbol table
subsystems.notes: SRP-002/SLM-453. New pack-local subsystem for the symbolic-regression pack (SRP-001/SLM-441, owner symbolic_regression_pack.py), pre-authorized by the downstream_extension_map row for SRP-002 (new_owner_justified: true, layer under output_contract, do not fork it). Variables and coefficients are opaque indices only -- never names or free numeric literals -- so the structural codec's output space is symbol-only by construction without introducing a second OUTPUT_CONTRACT_VERSION or reusing production_codec's OpenUI-specific encode/decode logic. Supersedes the untyped dict-shaped expression tree in symbolic_regression_pack.py as the canonical structural form; the Lark surface grammar registered there (dsl/grammar/backends/symbolic_regression.py) remains input-surface syntax only.

subsystems.name: Component-version registry and enforcement
subsystems.notes: Enforced by scripts/verify_version_stamps.py in CI, pre-commit, and agent hooks. Governs every other component id in this map.

subsystems.name: Cross-snapshot data-corpus leakage/dedup audit
subsystems.notes: AGENTS.md data-quality law: cross-snapshot overlap/leakage/near-dup auditing owner. New corpora (e.g. SRP-008 symbolic-regression corpus, VCE-008 split audits) run through this existing tool rather than a new leakage checker.

subsystems.name: Obligation x agent-harness-surface parity

subsystems.notes: Enforces ALLOWED_ROOTS and validate_skill_mirrors; executable counterpart to docs/repository-organization.md and .agents/skills/organize-repository/SKILL.md.

duplicate_subsystem_risks.evidence: Both cite ticket F1/SLM-34 as origin. Canonical has 114 importers incl. the dashboard pack API (web/routes.py); shadow has 7 importers, all confined to dsl/packs/* and harnesses/reasoning/bench.py.
duplicate_subsystem_risks.recommendation: New DSL packs (including SRP-001's symbolic-regression pack) register with the canonical dsl.pack.DslPack registry. Consolidating or retiring dsl/packs/ is out of scope for this audit (non-goal: no new semantic/search behavior) and should be filed as its own follow-up.

duplicate_subsystem_risks.evidence: controller.py (generic search controller, VSS1-02) docstring states the forest-specific LatticeSearchState in lattice_search.py is retained unchanged as an adapter beneath it.
duplicate_subsystem_risks.recommendation: Not a defect; record as an intentional layered design so future audits do not re-flag it.

known_drift.description: docs/design/symbol-only-output-contract.md stated 'The canonical contract is OUTPUT_CONTRACT_VERSION = 4' while src/slm_training/dsl/language_contract.py defines OUTPUT_CONTRACT_VERSION = 2. AGENTS.md, .cursor/rules/decode-invariants.mdc, docs/design/decode-invariants.md, and the current test suite (tests/test_dsl/test_language_contract.py) all agree with the code at 2. A prior investigation (docs/design/autotrain-cycle-a6r56e-c2-allowed-id-set-fingerprint-fix.md) found and fixed the same drift in the test suite but never fixed the design doc.
known_drift.fix: docs/design/symbol-only-output-contract.md corrected to cite OUTPUT_CONTRACT_VERSION = 2, matching src/slm_training/dsl/language_contract.py. scripts/verify_ownership_map.py now checks this pair on every run so the drift cannot silently return.

checkpoint_load_enforcement.description: OUTPUT_CONTRACT_VERSION is enforced a second, independent time at model-checkpoint load: require_current_output_contract() raises OutputContractError on any mismatch. A stale checkpoint is rejected outright, never silently reinterpreted (SGS-002 acceptance criterion).
